messages:
marta (sec-lead): heads-up — incoming pen-test vendor RedTeamCo booked 2026-04-02 09:00 PDT. Main asks: assessor access matrix, KMS decrypt grants for evidence artifacts, and log retention proofs. planning a 30m dry-run on 2026-04-01 10:00. @tess @pranav can you confirm if any RBAC changes are required or if we need a temporary KMS grant? cc @jon for telemetry retention rules.

Tess (eng-sre): noted. quick q — will assessors need cross-account access or will we provision ephemeral roles in our account? :eyes:

marta (sec-lead): they want ephemeral assume-role in our account (preferred). vendor gave a list of ARNs they will assume. They only need read-only object pulls + decrypts for a single key, and CloudWatch Read/Logs:Filter.

pranav (infra): ephemeral is fine. proposed flow: create role redteam/assessor-role with sts:AssumeRole from vendor principal, session duration 1h, permission boundary to read-only S3 + logs + kms:Decrypt (key policy must allow grant). We'll also attach an SCP to limit writes.

jon (platform): logging & telemetry: we need to capture evidence that assessor actions are fully audited. CloudWatch LogGroup for auditor sessions should be set to 365d retention for this engagement, and the API gateway / auth calls traced. Also enable object-level S3 access logs on redwood-pt-evidence bucket.

Tess (eng-sre): sample IAM policy for the role — please review:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence", "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"]
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["logs:GetLogEvents", "logs:FilterLogEvents"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:logs:us-west-2:123456789012:log-group:/redwood/pt/*"]
    },
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345-6789"]
    }
  ]
}
```

marta (sec-lead): that looks good. Important KMS note from legal: we can't hand over plaintext keys. We need to use KMS grants scoped to the key and to the role, audit logs for Decrypt must be retained 90+ days. @pranav can you confirm grant process?

pranav (infra): yes — will create a one-off KMS Grant scoped to the assessor-role with constraints: encryptionContext match {"evidence-origin":"redteamco"}. I'll record the grant ID and rotate it out post-engagement. We should also require the vendor to present a signed CSR for assume-role binding.

jon (platform): small addition — enable CloudTrail data events for S3 object reads (so we get object-level read entries) and send to locked S3 bucket with MFA-delete enabled for the retention period. That gives our compliance team the timeline proof.

marta (sec-lead): perfect. can we run the dry-run 4/1 and validate: assume-role, S3 read, KMS decrypt, and the CloudTrail + CloudWatch entries all show up in the evidence bucket? target 30m, with checklist.

Tess (eng-sre): I'll run a pre-dry-run self-check tomorrow and paste the checklist results. For the dry-run we should have an oncall (me) + infra (pranav) + sec (marta).

pranav (infra): will prepare grant + role in staging and replay the vendor assume flow. ETA for staging prep: 2026-03-30 EOD.

marta (sec-lead): action items: 1) pranaV: create role + KMS grant in staging (due 3/30) 2) tess: pre-dry-run checklist and runbook (due 3/31) 3) jon: enable CloudTrail data events and S3 access logging (due 3/31) 4) marta: confirm vendor ARNs and upload assessor whitelist (today).

jon (platform): I've scheduled a 30m dry-run calendar invite for 2026-04-01 10:00 PDT and added owners. audit-bot will attach meeting notes to the thread. :calendar:

audit-bot: automated note — CloudTrail data events will be enabled for bucket arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence. Retention policy set to 395 days in locked archive.

Tess (eng-sre): one last compatibility check — some of our models write to the same bucket with prefix /generated/. We'll create a prefix ACL to ensure assessors cannot access prefix /models/*; role policy will exclude resource arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/models/*

marta (sec-lead): good catch. make that explicit in the role policy and in the audit checklist. Also, for the retest window after remediation: we should schedule a second 1h slot week of 2026-04-15. I'll file the retest request once initial report is in.

pranav (infra): noted. I'll create CloudFormation snippet for role + grant and post here when ready.

Tess (eng-sre): +1. posting the pre-dry-run checklist in 1h.

marta (sec-lead): thanks team. leaving this thread open for artifacts. :wave:
